coverage.notes: All 45 non-test Go files in scope (controlplane/memory/mesh/lifecycle/cleanup/telemetry/state/receipt) + 10 supporting. Verified positives: prune queries scoped safe (acked-only, expired-unconsumed-only, age-gated dry-run); lease fencing token+state CAS; idempotent replay on receipt/mesh/telemetry/submit.

highlights: C-1 HIGH session_reap.go:162 - zombie reap os.RemoveAll dirty worktrees from autopilot tick (contradicts own stated intent; no dirty check, no liveness re-verify)
C-2 MED receipt.go:281 - receipts.db synchronous(NORMAL): consume ack lost on power loss => receipt replayable (controlplane/mesh use FULL)
C-3 MED telemetry engine.go:258 - batch flush discards acknowledged events on persist failure, no retry/outbox
C-4 MED telemetry retention 30d configured but NEVER enforced (no-op; prompt summaries retained forever)
C-5 MED mesh/store.go:61 - ledger.db NO schema versioning/migration (vs controlplane v11, receipt v5)
C-9 LOW receipt.go:1372 - PurgeExpired has NO production caller (receipts append-forever)
C-14 LOW retry.go:302 - ADR-0029 hourly retry budget process-local (restart resets; multiplies across coordinators)
